sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Cambodia visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Cambodia. You can apply online for a tourist eVisa before travelling, or get a visa on arrival at main airports.

sections.heading: Cambodia visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually have the same options, depending on their nationality. Check whether you also need to complete an online arrival form before you fly, as Cambodia has introduced one for travellers.

sections.heading: Cambodia eVisa tips
sections.text: Apply only through the official government system, as many websites look official but charge extra. Read the UK government travel advice, particularly for areas near the border with Thailand.

sections.heading: Cambodia visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Cambodia visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Cambodia.

faqs.q: Do I need a visa for Cambodia from the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. You can apply online for an eVisa or get a visa on arrival at main airports.

faqs.q: How long does a Cambodia visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Can you apply for my Cambodia visa for me?
faqs.a: Yes. Use our online form: upload your passport and we fill in your details, then we complete and check the Cambodia visa application and submit it for you.
